title: V5 TUI: compact PWM balance column (spendable/staked K/M/B)
brief: Apply same K/M/B compact formatting as marks column to Balance column: spendable and staked PWM coin amounts; no saturation coloring.
acceptance_criteria: format_balance_cell uses compact coin display for balance_pwm and staked (raw u128 -> PWM coin amount, then scale).
Scaling matches marks: <1000 integer; >=1K x.xxK; >=1M x.xxM; >=1B x.xxB (two decimals).
Staked layout preserved: {spendable}/{staked}PWM when staked>0; spendable-only when staked==0.
No red/special color on balance cells.
Prefer shared helper (e.g. format_amount_compact in marks_display or pwm-core display) — DRY with format_marks_compact where sensible.
Adjust Balance column Constraint::Length if needed so typical 21B-style rows fit.
Unit tests: small balance, K/M/B ranges, staked pair, genesis-scale billions.
cargo test -p pwm-tui --lib format_balance PASS; cargo check -p pwm-tui PASS.

artifacts.current_format: format_balance_cell: format_pwm full decimals -> 500/500PWM or long billions

notes: Owner verified marks compact UX manually; balance column still overflows on billion-scale genesis wallets.

delegation.invite_note:
TUI balance column compact formatting (follow-up to marks compact ticket).

Problem: format_balance_cell uses format_pwm with full integer strings — billions do not fit column.

Implement format_pwm_compact(raw: u128) or format_coin_compact(coin_units) with same rules as format_marks_compact.

Update format_balance_cell in models.rs:
- staked==0: compact spendable + optional " PWM" suffix policy (match existing: trim to {compact}PWM or {compact}/{staked}PWM)
- staked>0: {compact_bal}/{compact_staked}PWM

Reuse/extract shared compact scaler from marks_display.rs (u32 marks vs u128 PWM raw — convert raw to whole coin or fractional coin consistently; document choice in code comment).

No color styling.

Widen Balance column constraint in tui_loop if still tight.

Update models.rs tests (bal_cell_keeps_rpc_balance -> compact expectations).

Gates: cargo test -p pwm-tui --lib; cargo check -p pwm-tui.

Skill: colloquium-cqds-mcp; project_id: 5. Minimal diff.
